During its [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an '''outpost'''. The outpost was destroyed in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] during a [[Raid on an Imperial outpost|raid]] carried out by the [[Chubbit]] [[Chubbit resistance|resistance]] and led by an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi impersonator|actor]] pretending to be the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The raid was part of a plot by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to lure [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the planet.<ref name="CSW10" />
